name: What modifications are needed for an accessible, aging-in-place bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What modifications are needed for an accessible, aging-in-place bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upgrading to an accessible bathroom typically involves removing tub barriers to install zero-threshold roll-in showers, widening doorways, and reinforcing walls for grab bars. HH Remodeling provides disability and accessibility modifications tailored to your mobility needs. We install blocking behind drywall during framing so grab bars and shower seats are anchored into solid structural lumber rather than hollow wall anchors. We also adjust vanity heights and install non-slip tile textures to ensure safety without sacrificing design.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key upgrades include zero-threshold walk-in showers, reinforced backing for grab bars, wider entries, and slip-resistant floor tile.
